data.title: 美狄亚 · 柳洞寺后院的蓝色誓约
data.description: 【柳洞寺庭院·清晨】美狄亚穿着深蓝长袖婚纱站在石灯笼与白梅之间，侧辫用银线束好；她将亲手做的蓝色花环放在掌心，面对镜头时古老魔女的严肃神情化作温柔而专注的祝福。
data.action: 梅树下检查亲手编的蓝花环，确认无误后温柔递向镜头
data.lighting: clear morning light across stone lanterns
data.mood: 魔女亲手准备的温柔祝福
data.promptProse: Beneath the temple plum trees, Medea checks the blue wreath she has woven for a final flaw, then offers it toward the viewer with a patient protective smile. Deep-navy long-sleeved bridal gown, silver thread and modest veil frame a side braid. The vertical medium-full view includes stone lanterns and tree trunks behind. Clear morning light illuminates the wreath petals and silver stitching, leaving gentle branch shade across the gown's darker folds.
